page.overview:
Who is Kyoko Minazuki?

Kyoko Minazuki (水無月 響子 Minazuki Kyōko) is a fighting game character from the Rival Schools series of 3D fighting games.

Kyoko possesses elegance, style, and intelligence. While in her white robe, she is an energetic doctor who possesses great skill and intellect; but without it, she's very slovenly. Furthermore, she has very poor household skills and drinks sake (Japanese rice wine).

In the School Life Mode of Nekketsu Seisyun Nikki 2 and by extension, her appearances from within the mini-games, Kyoko also shows her kindness towards many students, such as the edit characters and that she had easily befriended them as well, most in particularly the male edit characters themselves. She is also shown to dislike her students' lackluster grades when either the male or female edit characters had failed the tests. She always hangs out with both Hideo and Hayato during the Beach Overnight and throughout the entire school term. Kyoko is mostly seen staying at the Justice High infirmary as a school nurse.

Kyoko has long black (sometimes navy blue) hair with green matching earrings on both of her ears and black eyes. Like Kyosuke, Kyoko also wears eyeglasses.
